title: 第15章 天若要其亡必先要其狂第16章 求干
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “不能冲动？不可草率？老六，你什么意思，难不成我林家就咽下这口气了？”
“那我林家以后在苍阳城还怎么抬头，岂不是会沦为笑话？”
八爷林长颓脾气最为火爆，闻言立即就不干了。
六爷林长羽看了一眼八爷，开口道：“老八，你别冲动，先听我说。”
族长林长恨也是瞪了一眼林长颓，“你个莽夫给我闭嘴，听听长羽怎么说，我林家就他最有脑子，先听听他的看法。”
林长颓听到这话，那是憋了一肚子火气，简直都快要炸了，但却还不得不忍下来。
林长羽看到林长颓不再闹腾，开口说道，“算是肯定不能算了的，但我们得换个方向，不能针对杨家，而是得针对那个李轩。”
“大家也都知道，杨家近几年来被我四大家族压迫的很惨，正所谓兔子急了还要咬人，又更何况是林家？”
“一旦我们去杨家要人，杨家被逼急了，万一真的破釜沉舟怎么办？”
“到时候，吃亏的还是我林家，另外三大家是肯定乐得坐山观虎斗的，即便是派人增援，也只会是做个样子。”
听到这话，所有林家人都沉默了下来。
因为林长羽说的是事实。
蛋糕本就这么大，若是把林家也踢出局，只有三家分，何乐而不为呢？
“如何针对那李轩？”林长恨问道，“那小子有杨家护着，我们又不敢真正激怒杨家，如此一来，怕是也难以针对吧？”
林长羽摇了摇头，露出了一抹莫测高深的笑容。
他本想卖关子，但眼看八爷又要瞪眼，只得无奈道：“造势，捧杀，借刀杀人。”
说着，他的眼睛便是忍不住眯了起来，开始说起了细节。
一刻钟后，林家人听完林长羽的计策，眼睛都是忍不住大亮。
八爷更是忍不住惊呼道：“卧槽，老六你真够阴险的啊，还得是你。”
杨家。
杨芊芊等人在离开后，李轩便是开始了修炼。
他没有提升修为，因为他已经达到了炼气境九重巅峰，单纯靠天地灵气，那是很难突破了，需要海量资源。
小院中，李轩取出了凡剑，开始了一次次的拔剑，斩剑。
嗖嗖嗖。
一道道剑光自小院中亮起，李轩很快便是斩出了数千剑。
一剑比一剑快，一剑比一剑猛，一剑比一剑消耗的灵气少。
足足两个时辰，李轩都在练剑，没有丝毫停歇。
当杨愈过来叫李轩吃饭的时候，看着李轩那赤果的精壮上身，俏脸唰的一下就红了。
她一颗心忍不住砰砰跳着，就犹如是小鹿乱撞。
她怎么都没有想到，李轩都已经那么强了，竟然还如此努力。
杨愈是过来招呼李轩吃饭的，用完晚饭，她又送李轩回到小院，忽然道，“有，有件事不知道该不该告诉你。”
“什么事？”李轩疑惑。
杨愈愤愤道：“也不知道是哪个王八蛋在造谣，说你在炼气境无敌，狂的很，看不起所有同阶。”
“不仅如此，你更是当众扬言，炼气境在你眼中就是垃圾，哪怕先天境一二重，在你眼里都是个屁，根本就不够看。”
李轩闻言一愣，“这是事实啊。”
她很想说：大哥，咱能别吹吗？
憋了好半晌，她才道：“可，可就算是事实，你并没有当众那么说过啊。”
“你知道吗？就是因为这件事，现在不少人都对你不满了呢，甚至很多人都已经决定，明天就来杨家挑战你。”
“那些人不仅有炼气境八九重，更是还有着先天境二三重。”
她显然是真的气，“这也太无耻了，不明摆着欺负人吗，肯定是林家做的。”
李轩闻言，眼睛却是忍不住亮了，“还有这样的事？好事啊！”
content_en:
"Don't be impulsive? Don't be hasty? Lao Liu, what do you mean? Could it be that my Lin family has to swallow this?"
"Then if we, the Lin family, will raise our heads in Cangyang City in the future, won't we become a joke?"
The eighth master, Lin Changcai, had the hottest temper and quit immediately after hearing this.
The Sixth Master, Lin Changyu, glanced at the Eighth Master and said, "Lao Ba, don't be impulsive. Listen to me first."
The clan leader, Lin Changhen, also glared at Lin Changdei, "Shut up, you reckless man, and listen to what Chang Yu has to say. He is the wisest in our Lin family, so let's hear his opinion first."
When Lin Changyao heard this, he was so angry that he was about to explode, but he still had to endure it.
Lin Changyu saw that Lin Changdean was no longer making a fuss and said, "We definitely can't let it go, but we have to change the direction. We can't target the Yang family, but Li Xuan."
"Everyone knows that the Yang family has been severely oppressed by my four major families in recent years. As the saying goes, rabbits bite when they are anxious, let alone the Lin family?"
"Once we go to the Yang family to ask for someone, the Yang family is forced into a panic. What if everything is really ruined?"
"At that time, it will be my Lin family who will suffer the loss. The other three families will definitely be happy to sit back and watch the fight. Even if they send reinforcements, it will only be a show."
Hearing this, all the Lin family fell silent.
Because what Lin Changyu said is true.
The cake is already so big. If the Lin family is also kicked out and only three families get a share, why not?
"How to target Li Xuan?" Lin Changhen asked, "That kid is protected by the Yang family, and we don't dare to really anger the Yang family. In this case, it will be difficult to target him, right?"
Lin Changyu shook his head and showed an unpredictable smile.
He originally wanted to show off, but seeing Master Ba glare again, he had no choice but to say: "Build momentum, kill with support, kill with a borrowed knife."
As he spoke, he couldn't help but narrow his eyes and began to talk about the details.
A quarter of an hour later, after listening to Lin Changyu's plan, the Lin family's eyes couldn't help but brighten.
Master Ba couldn't help but exclaimed: "Damn it, Liu, you are so insidious, it has to be you."
Lin Changyu: "..."
Yang family.
After Yang Qianqian and others left, Li Xuan started practicing.
He did not improve his cultivation because he had already reached the peak of the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm. It would be difficult to break through simply relying on the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and it would require massive resources.
In the small courtyard, Li Xuan took out the mortal sword and began to draw and slash the sword again and again.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh.
Lines of sword light lit up from the small courtyard, and Li Xuan quickly slashed out thousands of swords.
One sword is faster than the other, more powerful than the other, and consumes less spiritual energy than the other.
For two full hours, Li Xuan practiced his sword without any pause.
When Yang Yu came over to ask Li Xuan to eat, he looked at Li Xuan's naked upper body and his pretty face turned red.
Her heart couldn't help but beat like a deer.
She never thought that Li Xuan, who was already so strong, would work so hard.
Yang Yu came over to greet Li Xuan for dinner. After dinner, she sent Li Xuan back to the small courtyard and suddenly said, "Yes, there is something I don't know if I should tell you."
"What's the matter?" Li Xuan was confused.
Yang Yu said angrily: "I don't know which bastard is spreading rumors, saying that you are invincible in the Qi Refining Realm. You are so crazy that you look down on everyone at the same level."
"Not only that, you even publicly declared that the Qi Refining Realm is rubbish in your eyes. Even the first or second level of the Xiantian Realm is nothing in your eyes. It's not good enough at all."
Li Xuan was stunned when he heard this, "This is a fact."
Yang Yu: "..."
She wanted to say: Brother, can we stop bragging?
After holding it in for a long time, she said: "But, even if it is the truth, you didn't say that in public."
"Did you know? Because of this incident, many people are dissatisfied with you now. Many people have even decided to come to the Yang family to challenge you tomorrow."
"Those people are not only at the eighth or ninth level of the Qi Refining Realm, but they are also at the second or third level of the Innate Realm."
She was obviously really angry, "This is too shameless. Isn't it obvious that you are bullying people? It must be the Lin family."
When Li Xuan heard this, his eyes couldn't help but light up, "Is there such a thing? What a good thing!"
